sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B: Open 33B Agent Model, 80.9 on Terminal-Bench ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a new open-weight dense model released on October 24, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license, built for coding and office-style agents. The model card on Hugging Face reports that it leads three comparable 30B-class models on most agentic benchmarks, including 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

sources.title: Nanbeige Opens 33B Model Under Apache 2.0 With 512K Context - AI Weekly
sources.snippet: Nanbeige LLM Lab has posted Nanbeige4.3-33B on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, a 33B-parameter model with a 524,288-token context window and reasoning enabled by default.

sources.title: Nanbeige Releases Open 33B Model for Agentic Coding - AI Brief
sources.snippet: Chinese AI lab Nanbeige released Nanbeige4.3-33B, an open-weight model for agentic coding and work tasks, under the Apache 2.0 license, as detailed on its Hugging Face page. It supports a context window of up to 524,288 tokens and will serve as a teacher for distilling agent skills into smaller models, including a planned 3B version.
